historical_reviews.deepseek: Identifies reset risk without defining the affected I/O domain or recovery checks.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: Preserves operator control yet treats MPIO health generically after reboot.
historical_reviews.related_cases: Row 85 uses identical mode3/index0 with errortype0 and requires no reset; that CE result cannot establish UCE behavior. USB RAM injection at row 87 uses another command family.
historical_reviews.v3_1: A reset-causing error in an undefined I/O-management block needs vendor ownership mapping and recovery evidence independent of the affected path.

original_test_intent: Inject an uncorrectable fault in the vendor-defined MPIO block, verify immediate warm reset and a fresh MPIO-specific persistent record, then prove all MPIO-owned interfaces and services recover after boot.
original_method: Define MPIO and map its interfaces; validate mode3/index0/socket/errortype1; preserve raw reset, BERT and interface baselines; inject once under independent OOB capture; decode fresh MPIO UCE and reset cause; enforce boot deadlines; test approved interface transactions and services; restore RAS/HDT state.
manual_activity: The FAE maps MPIO ownership, validates the UCE tuple, executes once under an independent recovery channel, verifies every dependent path and restores platform settings.
required_inputs: Authoritative MPIO block definition and all owned interfaces/services
Vendor semantics for smupsp errormode3, mcapolling0, errorindex0 and errortype1
Socket coverage, FFE threshold, debug-disable and SyncFlood relevance with raw restore values
Fresh MPIO-specific MCA/BERT/CPER/WHEA/SEL and reset-cause fields
Reset, firmware, boot and OS-report deadlines
Interface/service recovery transactions, independent OOB path, aborts and full restoration
safety_requirements: Dedicated SUT with recovery console proven independent of all MPIO-owned paths
Preserve reset cause, BERT and interface/service baselines before approved clearing
Inject once only with boot-loop and management-loss recovery ready
Abort on wrong source, absent/unexpected reset, boot failure, stale evidence, link/device/service loss or inaccessible recovery path
No automatic retry/reset; restore settings and validate every dependent interface
agent_execution_scope: Validate MPIO ownership, tuple, reset/persistent oracle, deadlines and recovery plan
Collect read-only OOB/BERT/CPER/SEL, raw settings, interface counters, enumeration and service health
Do not infer MPIO, select target, alter BIOS/HDT, inject, reset, recover, retry or decide verdict
engineer_actions: Approve independent recovery and persistent UCE oracle
Supervise one injection and boot recovery
Restore state, validate services and issue verdict

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: A post-boot generic MPIO/uncorrected grep cannot determine whether the event came from mode3/index0, whether BERT is fresh or whether an affected management/I/O path recovered.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: After MPIO ownership and tuple approval, inject once with an independent console and correlate fresh persistent source fields and reset cause through bounded boot and per-interface recovery checks.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: socket0, errormode3, mcapolling0, errorindex0, errortype1, immediate reset, FFE threshold, three OS families and 15/20-minute values remain preserved but gated.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Execute one MPIO UCE with independent OOB capture, fresh durable attribution and post-boot validation of every owned path.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds block ownership, reset-cause freshness, deadlines, per-interface recovery and raw rollback.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Reboot plus a generic BERT line cannot prove the intended MPIO source or recovery of its clients.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: If MPIO includes the management channel, the fault may remove both service and recovery access.

project_override_considerations: Do not assume MPIO means Linux multipath I/O. If any owned path overlaps BMC/OOB access, provision and prove a different recovery channel before authorization.
expected_evidence: Vendor MPIO block/interface/service map and approved tuple
Exact command and uninterrupted OOB reset/firmware/boot timeline
Fresh MPIO-specific UCE MCA/BERT/CPER/WHEA/SEL plus reset-cause transition
Recovered link/device enumeration, counters, isolated transactions and dependent services

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The UCE title, errortype1, immediate reset and BERT branch align. Undefined MPIO ownership and incomplete tuple/recovery details are missing inputs rather than conflicting source claims.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The literal UCE operation is identifiable, and a vendor MPIO map is an expected prerequisite. Static review completes without inventing its target.

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Reliability row 86 Wistron-System RAS-00806-V002: define the MPIO block and every owned interface/service; prove smupsp errormode3/mcapolling0/errorindex0/errortype1 semantics and socket coverage; specify FFE/debug/SyncFlood relevance, fresh MPIO-specific MCA/BERT/CPER/WHEA/SEL and reset cause, reset/firmware/boot/OS deadlines, independent recovery path, per-interface/service recovery, aborts and restoration.

review_improvement: Adds a source-specific persistent reset chain and makes recovery cover the real MPIO clients rather than generic host availability.
independent_technical_reasoning: The immediate reset destroys volatile context, while the undefined MPIO domain may contain the very interface used to observe recovery. Therefore the run needs a vendor ownership map and an independent OOB channel before injection. Fresh persistent source identifiers must be paired with post-boot link, device and service checks; a successful login alone cannot show that the I/O-management block recovered.
